tests.title: Book an available appointment slot for a QA customer
tests.goal: A QA customer can book an available resource/service slot and receive a recorded appointment.
preconditions: A staging appointment resource and service have an available slot.
The staging notification route is confirmed safe for a non-routable QA contact.
data: QA customer with example.invalid email and test-only phone.
Available resource, service, date, and time selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Appointments.
Choose an available resource, service, date, and time.
Enter QA-only contact details and submit the booking.

expected.text: The appointment record shows the selected service, resource, date, and time.
The appointment has a confirmed/booked state and is linked to the QA customer.
No message reaches a real person.

checks.label: The appointment record shows the selected service, resource, date, and time.
The appointment has a confirmed/booked state and is linked to the QA customer.
No message reaches a real person.

notes: CRM Appointments cannot show anything (403 on all appointment APIs). Booked instead from the eShop as guest Siu Ming Wong (example.com): resource Course, service Thai, 2026-10-29 14:00-14:30 -> "Your appointment is scheduled", record page token f99476b6...; validation OK (required fields, numeric mobile, email format). Overlapping slots 13:45/14:00/14:15 disappear afterwards. Not visible in the CRM.

tests.title: Redeem loyalty points and reconcile balance and checkout discount
tests.goal: Redeeming available QA loyalty points applies the configured value and updates the member balance once.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA member has sufficient points and a sandbox checkout method is available.
data: Eligible product and point amount selected within the current redemption rules.

steps.text: Record the QA member points balance and redemption conversion rule.
Add an eligible product to an isolated cart and apply the selected points.
Review the checkout discount and complete only through the documented sandbox method.
Reopen the member balance and order history.

expected.text: The discount matches the configured point conversion.
The member balance decreases by the redeemed points exactly once.
The order history links the redemption to the QA order.

checks.label: The discount matches the configured point conversion.
The member balance decreases by the redeemed points exactly once.
The order history links the redemption to the QA order.

notes: New member MEMy001164526 (500 register points). Rule: 100 points = $100, max $100 per order; entering 150 is clamped to 100. Applied $100 on product test 2 (HKD 1,000, basket -300) -> total 600; Bank Transfer order TXN0126102700019; CRM shows Cash dollar -$100 and total $600. Point History "Cash Dollar, Order no. TXN0126102700019, -100" -> 400. Voided in CRM -> "Void - Cash Dollar +100" -> 500 (no order no. on the void line).

tests.title: Eligible cart items receive the promotion-code discount
tests.goal: An eligible product receives the discount defined by an active promotion code in the storefront cart.
preconditions: An active code-based promotion and an eligible product are available in staging.
data: Active promotion code and eligible product selected from current storefront data.

steps.text: Open the staging storefront in a clean, isolated test session.
Choose an active promotion that has a code and identify an eligible product.
Add the eligible product to the isolated cart and enter the promotion code.
Review the cart discount and remove the test item.

expected.text: The code is accepted for the eligible item and the displayed discount matches the promotion rule.
Removing the test item leaves the isolated cart empty and no order is created.

checks.label: The code is accepted for the eligible item and the displayed discount matches the promotion rule.
Removing the test item leaves the isolated cart empty and no order is created.

notes: VIP888 on product C (HKD 600): line -> HKD 580 (606, -$20 each) plus order -$20 (605) -> HKD 560. 607 (20% off) not applied: asked as storeberry-compare question. Cart emptied afterwards, no order.

tests.title: Free-gift promotion offers its gift when the threshold is met
tests.goal: An eligible cart displays the configured free gift when the promotion threshold is reached.
preconditions: An active free-gift promotion with an attainable threshold and eligible products is available in staging.
data: Promotion threshold and eligible product group selected from current staging data.

steps.text: Open the staging storefront in a clean, isolated test session.
Choose an active free-gift promotion and its eligible product group.
Add eligible products until the displayed promotion threshold is met.
Review the cart gift offer, then remove the test items.

expected.text: The qualifying cart displays the gift selection or gift item specified by the promotion.
The promotion is not offered before its threshold is met.
Removing the test items leaves the isolated cart empty and no order is created.

checks.label: The qualifying cart displays the gift selection or gift item specified by the promotion.
The promotion is not offered before its threshold is met.
Removing the test items leaves the isolated cart empty and no order is created.

notes: Promotion 631 (net >= $800, pick 1 of Group A): not offered at net HKD 560, offered at net HKD 1,260 (C + product test 2); gift ewqe added at HKD 0.00 (1/1). 630 ($1,500 net) correctly not offered. Removing product test 2 removed the gift automatically. Cart emptied, no order. Stale add-on after removal: storeberry-compare BUG-013.
